The '''2015 Copa Libertadores second stage''' was played from February 17 to April 22, 2015. A total of 32 teams competed in the second stage to decide the 16 places in the [[2015 Copa Libertadores final stages|final stages]] of the [[2015 Copa Libertadores]].<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento_copa_bridgestone_libertadores_2015.pdf|title=Copa Bridgestone Libertadores 2015 – Reglamento|language=Spanish|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>

==Draw==
The draw of the tournament was held on December 2, 2014, 21:00 [[UTC−03:00|UTC−3]], at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].

For the second stage, the 32 teams were drawn into eight groups of four containing one team from each of the four seeding pots. The seeding of each team was determined by their association and qualifying berth (as per the rotational agreement established by CONMEBOL, the teams which qualified through berths 1 from Colombia, Ecuador, Peru and Venezuela were seeded into Pot 1 for odd-numbered years, while the teams which qualified through berths 1 from Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay were seeded into Pot 1 for even-numbered years).<ref name="regulations"/> Teams from the same association in Pots 1 and 2 could not be drawn into the same group. However, a first stage winner, whose identity was not known at the time of the draw, could be drawn into the same group with another team from the same association.

The six winners of the [[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage|first stage]] which joined the 26 direct entrants were as follows:
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G1|Winner G1]]: {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Club Atlético Huracán|Huracán]]
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G2|Winner G2]]: {{flagicon|ARG}} [[Estudiantes de La Plata|Estudiantes]]
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G3|Winner G3]]: {{flagicon|VEN}} [[Deportivo Táchira]]
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G4|Winner G4]]: {{flagicon|BOL}} [[The Strongest]]
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G5|Winner G5]]: {{flagicon|CHI}} [[Club Deportivo Palestino|Palestino]]
*[[2015 Copa Libertadores first stage#Match G6|Winner G6]]: {{flagicon|BRA}} [[Sport Club Corinthians Paulista|Corinthians]]

==Format==
In the second stage, each group was played on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The winners and runners-up of each group advanced to the [[2015 Copa Libertadores final stages|round of 16]].

===Tiebreakers===
The teams were ranked according to [[Points (association football)|points]] (3 points for a win, 1 point for a draw, 0 points for a loss). If tied on points, tiebreakers were applied in the following order:<ref name="regulations"/>
#[[Goal difference]] in all games;
#Goals scored in all games;
#Goals scored in all away games;
#Drawing of lots.

==Groups==
The matches were played on February 17–19, 24–26, March 3–5, 10–12, 17–19, April 1, 7–9, 14–16, and 21–22, 2015.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/16092015-1654/se-establecio-el-calendario-de-la-bridgestone-libertadores-2015|title=Se estableció el calendario de la Bridgestone Libertadores 2015|language=Spanish|date=December 29, 2014|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref>
